expected_behavior.description: Dip your weapon into a nearby surface to coat it with that element, adding bonus elemental damage to your next attack.

notes: Self-targeted bonus action that coats equipped weapon with a nearby surface's element (fire, poison, acid, etc.). Requires a valid surface within 3m range. Effect list in common_actions.json is empty — the actual coating logic depends on SurfaceManager interaction. WARNING: Surface interaction and Dip coating pipeline may be incomplete (Phase C surfaces). Likely blocked without a pre-placed surface in the scenario.
